claim.zh: DFM 让 AI 走完一整圈发现：从找到值得研究的问题，到用真实证据检验，再到把方法留给下一次。
claim.en: DFM takes an AI through a whole turn of discovery: find a question worth asking, test it against real evidence, keep what worked for next time.

claim.zh: 科学家和 AI 搭档一问一答，追问、修改、采纳都被记下来，AI 的工作环境在一轮轮反馈里变好。
claim.en: A scientist and an AI partner talk it through; every follow-up, edit and acceptance is written down, and the AI's workspace gets better round by round.

claim.zh: 把一个真实的科研代码库变成一排可以运行、可以打分、可以重复的工作台，让 AI 在真实科学任务里做事并被检验。
claim.en: Turn a real scientific codebase into a row of workbenches that run, get scored and can be repeated, so an AI can work on real scientific tasks and be checked.

claim.zh: 在动手之前先预测：如果这样做，世界会变成什么样，哪条路值得走。
claim.en: Predict before acting: if we do this, what does the world look like, and which option is worth taking.

claim.zh: 科学家带来真实问题、数据和实验反馈，PhAI 带来模型、工具和分析，在真实实验里一起验证，结果回到科学家手里。
claim.en: Scientists bring real problems, data and experimental feedback; PhAI brings models, tools and analysis; results are tested together in real experiments and go back to the scientist.

claim.zh: 官网重构：中英双语，结构化数据维护。
